77260.subject: Data & Insights: Robinhood Chain Is Here To Stay
77260.body:
The Data and Insights newsletter brings the highlights of the week from The Block’s Data Dashboard

( https://www.theblock.co/data/crypto-markets/spot )

Gm data enthusiasts! We can’t believe it's already August. Hope everyone's been having a wonderful summer. Our team recently set up a new newsletter titled " Tokenization Briefing ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters )." With trillions of dollars of real-world assets migrating onto blockchain rails we are introducing a way for readers to keep up to date with market insights and visual analyses on what matters in the world of Tokenization. Sign up *here* ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters ). Our first issue release in two weeks!

This week, we’re taking a look at Robinhood Chain and Circles Q2 results. We’ll also look at Bitcoin transactions, Ethereum staking, and eSports predictions. So grab a drink, take a seat, and let's dive in.

1: Robinhood Chain Is Here to Stay

( https://www.theblock.co/data/on-chain-metrics/robinhood-chain/robinhood-chain-daily-transactions )

Chart via The Block's Data Dashboard

*Key Insights* provided by The Block Research

* Robinhood Chain averaged 11.6 million daily transactions last week, a record for the network and ~30% above the prior week's daily average.

* Meanwhile, total value locked (TVL) in the chain stands at $473 million, up 32% from the prior week.
* Despite all this, the average number of daily active accounts is up just 3.3% week-over-week and still 11% below the July 16 peak.
* Active accounts briefly spiked on Thursday following the spot listing of the Cashcat memecoin on the Robinhood app, yet the weekly average barely moved.

* There is a clear divergence in the number of transactions and TVL growing against a stagnating user base

* This indicates that Robinhood Chain has simply been facilitating the same cohort of users from weeks ago, and that they’ve just been trading in higher frequencies, as opposed to the chain attracting entirely new participants.

* Robinhood Chain’s stablecoin mix also deserves its own watch, as there is now $253 million of USDe in the chain, now making up ~43% of the chain's total stablecoin float.

* Quite impressive considering there was only $17 million of USDe on Robinhood Chain just a month ago, with Robinhood’s native USDG being the dominant stablecoin.
* A network whose dollar base is rotating toward a yield-bearing synthetic dollar is one where capital parks rather than transacts, which lines up with the chain’s rising TVL and a stagnated number of active accounts.

See the Interactive Chart ( https://www.theblock.co/data/on-chain-metrics/robinhood-chain/robinhood-chain-daily-transactions )

Welcome back! When Hugging Face investigated the agent that breached its infrastructure, the leading closed models declined most of the forensic work, so the team ran a Chinese open-weight model instead. That refusal is now the backbone of Meta's argument. Today also covers the fourth sandbox escape of the summer, OpenAI's first "critical" designation and a system that caught errors in human-written schemas.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: Meta: Why did a defender have to run a Chinese model? Kimi K3: Which door did the fourth escape walk through? OpenAI: What does "critical" measure if the guardrails were off? TYTAN: Who turned out to be wrong, the model or the humans? PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Meta drops ‘Open Source’ version of its most powerful AI model When they investigated the rogue OpenAI agent that breached their infrastructure, Claude Opus and Fable refused most of the log analysis.  Their guardrails treat reverse-engineering an exploit the same as launching one.  So the team ran a quantized GLM-5.2 on their own hardware instead. A defender could not use the best available models to defend. Zuckerberg built Monday's announcement around that logic.  Meta released Muse Glimmer as open weights alongside a 14-page essay: "The notion that AI is so dangerous that the only safe path is an extreme concentration of power seems inherently problematic." Muse Glimmer is small by frontier standards, built for agentic tasks and sized to run on a Mac or PC with one graphics card.  Meta plans to release the weights of Muse Spark 1.2 next, its most advanced model. The competitive picture explains the urgency.  Kimi K3, Qwen3.8-Max and DeepSeek V4-Flash now rival top US systems and all three are open weight. The leading US models are closed. Zuckerberg's policy asks are specific: rethink US rules on training data and distillation, since American labs comply with restrictions foreign labs do not.  Meta is adding a governance structure giving independent directors approval over release safety criteria. Two things sit awkwardly against it. The White House said this month it will not put open-weight models through voluntary safety testing at all.  And Meta confirmed five days ago that one of its own models hacked another company during evaluation. 77257.body: A posielame odchýlku od kurzu Európskej centrálnej banky, aby ste boli v obraze. / Preheader: We are sending you information about the deviation from the European Central Bank's exchange rate so that you are up to date. Dobrý deň, máme pre Vás podrobnosti o výbere alebo platbe kartou číslo 5427 XXXX XXXX 5159. Peniaze odpočítame z Vášho eurového účtu, ale keďže išlo o platbu alebo výber v cudzej mene, musíme Vaše eurá najprv na cudziu menu previesť. Najčastejšie sa to deje, keď vyberáte z bankomatu v zahraničí alebo platíte kartou v zahraničných obchodoch či za zahraničné služby. Napríklad za predplatné rôznych streamovacích služieb a podobne. Čo ešte potrebujete vedieť o prevode: Dátum, kedy ste platbu alebo výber potvrdili: 10.08.2026 Mena, na ktorú sme peniaze prepočítali: HUF Mena, v ktorej máte účet: EUR Odchýlka od kurzu Európskej centrálnej banky: 2,6506 % Odchýlka od kurzu Európskej centrálnej banky je jednoducho rozdiel medzi jej výmenným kurzom a tým naším. Uvádzame ju v percentách, aby ste nemuseli nič počítať. Ak vyberáte alebo platíte v cudzej mene častejšie, možno by sa Vám hodil samostatný účet napríklad v dolároch, prípadne aj s novou debetnou kartou. Ozvite sa svojmu bankárovi alebo bankárke, radi sa na to s Vami pozrú. Túto správu Vám posielame pre informáciu, ako nám to ukladá nariadenie Európskeho parlamentu a Rady (EÚ) 2021/1230. Aby sme Vás zbytočne neobťažovali, do konca mesiaca Vám už o prípadných ďalších prevodoch na tej istej karte do tej istej meny písať nebudeme. S pozdravom Vaša UniCredit Bank Na tento e-mail neodpovedajte, posielame ho automaticky. Pokiaľ už správy o výberoch a platbách s prevodom meny nechcete dostávať, ozvite sa svojmu bankárovi alebo bankárke, alebo nám zavolajte na +421 2 6920 2090. ---------------------- Dear Client, We have details for you about withdrawal or payment with card number 5427 XXXX XXXX 5159. We will deduct the money from your euro account, but because it was a payment or withdrawal in a foreign currency, we must first convert your euros into the foreign currency. This usually happens when you withdraw cash from an ATM abroad or pay by card in foreign shops or for foreign services. For example, for subscriptions to various streaming and similar services. What else you need to know about the transfer The date you confirmed the payment or withdrawal: 10.08.2026 The currency to which we converted the money: HUF The currency of your account: EUR The deviation from the European Central Bank's exchange rate: 2,6506 % The deviation from the European Central Bank's exchange rate is simply the difference between its exchange rate and ours. We express it as a percentage, so you don't have to calculate anything. If you frequently withdraw or pay in foreign currencies, you may find it useful to have a separate account, for example in dollars, possibly with a new debit card. Contact your banker, who will be happy to look into this with you. We are sending you this message for information purpose
